doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Claire's dash is the held Skate (RimewrightKit.in_dash), on the ground and, since owner item 62, in the air (pressed in the air it starts at once). The slide of the Rimelock statue she casts from a skate counts as the skate going on, so skate -> X is a fire (item 64). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Data: Skate is a held mode, released to stop. Footage (0239-0245, 0285-0290): she fires the whole skate and the darts become straight thick beams. Ours: darts fly as beams at normal damage (data pass); the skate goes on.

rmb.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the spear aim and throw go on while she keeps skating.

e.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the Rink Wall's tell and slide start while she keeps skating.

x.source: Data: the ult makes her invulnerable inside a slowing zone; footage (ult f25-f55): she is rooted in the crystal. Owner items 64/65: the skate's velocity and direction go on into the ult as a frozen statue that slides on its ice (x.carry_t 0.8 s, easing to a stop, no steering or turning), then she is rooted. Symmetric with item 27 (Shift out of the ult keeps momentum).

q.source: No source glove; the skate is a held move, so a glove goes off from it like her abilities.

lmb.source: Same as the ground skate: the air skate is the same held mode (owner item 62), the darts turn to beams while she skates in the air too.

rmb.source: Same as the ground skate (owner item 62).

e.source: Same as the ground skate (owner item 62).

x.source: Same as the ground skate (owner items 62/64): an ult cast from the air skate keeps its velocity and direction as the sliding statue.

q.source: Same as the ground skate (owner item 62).

lmb.source: Footage: she starts skating while firing and keeps firing; the darts turn to beams. Ours: the same.

rmb.source: Data: Skate can be held at any time. Ours: Shift during the spear aim or the throw's wind-up starts the skate and the throw still goes.

e.source: Data: Skate can be held at any time. Ours: Shift during the wall's 0.2s tell starts the skate and the wall still erupts.

x.source: Data: reactivating ends Chilling Finale early. Owner item 27: Shift ends Rimelock (as X again would; a late press still cracks it open) and she skates straight out at full speed, in the air too (item 62).

q.source: No source glove; the skate starts and the glove's effect stays.

x.reason: Owner item 65: she is a frozen statue; only the recast and Shift end it.
x.source: Owner item 65; footage (ult f25-f55): she is rooted in the crystal.
